import random, subprocess, sys, bisect
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from audit import decode_image
U=1<<128
random.seed(4242)

def gen_tree(R):
    nodes=[]
    def rec(i,j):
        span=j-i
        leaf = span<=8 and (span==1 or random.random()<0.45)
        if leaf:
            idx=len(nodes); nodes.append([i,j,[]]); return idx
        maxb=min(9,span)
        b=random.randint(2,maxb)
        cuts=sorted(random.sample(range(1,span),b-1))
        bounds=[i]+[i+x for x in cuts]+[j]
        idx=len(nodes); nodes.append([i,j,[]])
        ch=[rec(bounds[k],bounds[k+1]) for k in range(b)]
        nodes[idx][2]=ch
        return idx
    root=rec(0,R)
    order=[]; mp={}; qu=[root]
    while qu:
        old=qu.pop(0); mp[old]=len(order); order.append(old)
        qu.extend(nodes[old][2])
    rows=[]
    for old in order:
        i,j,ch=nodes[old]
        rows.append([i,j-i,[mp[c] for c in ch]])
    return rows

for trial in range(500):
    R=random.randint(1,40)
    starts=[0]
    for _ in range(R-1):
        if random.random()<0.2: starts.append(starts[-1]+random.randint(1,1<<100))
        elif random.random()<0.2: starts.append(starts[-1]+random.randint(1,1<<40))
        else: starts.append(starts[-1]+random.randint(1,1000000))
    hops=[None if random.random()<0.2 else random.randint(0,2**31-1) for _ in range(R)]
    rows=gen_tree(R)
    lines=[f'PACK {R} {len(rows)} 0']
    lines += [f'{s:032x} {-1 if h is None else h}' for s,h in zip(starts,hops)]
    for lo,span,ch in rows:
        spread=starts[lo+span-1]-starts[lo]
        legal=[0]
        if spread < (1<<64): legal.append(1)
        if spread < (1<<32): legal.append(2)
        mode=random.choice(legal)
        lines.append(' '.join(map(str,[lo,span,mode,random.randint(0,1),len(ch),*ch])))
    addrs=[random.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(30)] + starts + [U-1,0]
    lines[0]=f'PACK {R} {len(rows)} {len(addrs)}'
    lines += [f'{a:032x}' for a in addrs]
    proc=subprocess.run(['tmp/engine_test'],input=('\n'.join(lines)+'\n').encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if proc.returncode:
        print('engine fail',trial,proc.stderr.decode()); raise SystemExit(1)
    out=proc.stdout.decode().splitlines(); image=out[0]
    nodes,size=decode_image(image,starts,hops)
    def lookup(a):
        off=64; path=[]
        while True:
            path.append(off); nd=nodes[off]
            if nd['kind']==1:
                r=nd['lo']+bisect.bisect_right(nd['keys'],a)-1
                return (hops[r],r,path)
            off=nd['children'][bisect.bisect_right(nd['keys'],a)]
    expect=[lookup(a) for a in addrs]
    got=[]
    for line in out[1:]:
        vals=list(map(int,line.split()));
        if vals[2]!=len(vals)-3: print('framing');raise SystemExit(1)
        got.append((None if vals[0]==-1 else vals[0],vals[1],vals[3:]))
    if got!=expect:
        print('PACK answer mismatch trial',trial,R)
        for i,(g,e) in enumerate(zip(got,expect)):
            if g!=e: print(i,hex(addrs[i]),g,e); break
        raise SystemExit(1)
    tr=[f'TRACE {len(addrs)}',image]+[f'{a:032x}' for a in addrs]
    p2=subprocess.run(['tmp/engine_test'],input=('\n'.join(tr)+'\n').encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p2.returncode:
        print('trace fail',trial,p2.stderr.decode()); raise SystemExit(1)
    got2=[]
    for line in p2.stdout.decode().splitlines():
        vals=list(map(int,line.split())); got2.append((None if vals[0]==-1 else vals[0],vals[1],vals[3:]))
    if got2!=expect:
        print('TRACE mismatch',trial); print(got2[:3],expect[:3]); raise SystemExit(1)
print('PACK/TRACE random PASS')
